missed.note: The reader user story says "discover articles by author and tag". Only author-based discovery gets an acceptance criterion (AC-10); tag-based discovery (also offered as a query param at attachments/api-contract.md#L11) has no criterion, rule, or outcome anywhere in the contract. The contract's own coverage ledger notes this omission ("Discovery by tag has no acceptance criterion of its own") but the requirement itself remains untested by any item in the contract.

summary: The contract is a careful, largely literal transcription of story.md and attachments/api-contract.md: every AC, rule, error-model row and endpoint checked matches its cited source line for value and condition, gaps G1-G3 are honestly scoped to mechanics rather than invented behaviour, and the coverage ledger accounts for every bulleted source line. The only real gap is tag-based article discovery (story.md#L24), which is named as a reader want and as an API query parameter but never turned into a testable criterion; a couple of AC-11 outcomes and AC-19's entryPoint also lean on the plain meaning of terms (pagination, "home page") slightly beyond the literal quote, noted above but not treated as failures.
